title: Elevated 500 errors and slow response times in Checkout API
description: Checkout API is experiencing a sharp spike in HTTP 502/504 errors and p99 latency exceeding 4000ms immediately following release v2.4.1. Upstream services report gateway timeouts.

title: Orders service database connection pool acquisition timeout
description: The orders-service API is failing order placements with HTTP 500 errors. Application logs indicate connection acquisition timeouts to Postgres database pool.

title: Inventory service memory exhaustion and severe CPU throttling
description: The inventory-service heap memory utilization exceeded 94% threshold, triggering stop-the-world JVM garbage collection cycles and CPU saturation at 96%.

title: Notification delivery latency spike across inter-service calls
description: Notification service request queue depth increased by 300%. Initially suspected to be an application worker deadlock, but telemetry indicates network MTU fragmentation and TCP resets.

title: Billing service authentication tokens rejected after config change
description: Billing service is rejecting all internal microservice API calls with 401/403 unauthorized errors following an updated runtime configuration deployment.

title: Search service latency degradation unresolved by restart
description: Search query response times elevated above 3200ms. Initial hypothesis attributed this to search-service cache invalidation, but root issue resides in downstream elasticsearch cluster.

title: Reporting service query stall preceded recent deployment
description: Reporting service report generation stalled. SRE suspects release v3.4.0 deployed at 09:30, but metrics prove anomaly onset began 45 minutes prior at 08:45.

title: Auth service external authentication DNS resolution failure
description: User login attempts failing intermittently with DNS resolution SERVFAIL timeouts attempting to reach external authoritative identity provider.

title: Payment gateway transit carrier packet loss outage
description: Outbound credit card charges dropping packets at external peering exchange; 48% packet loss observed on external transit gateway.

title: Sparse telemetry on recommendation service background worker
description: Background recommendation pipeline throughput slowed. Log volume is below sample threshold and metrics show no distinct change-points.

title: Uncataloged container disk I/O starvation on logistics fleet
description: Newly deployed fleet container reported unhandled I/O wait spike and journal write blocks uploaded via manual diagnostics snapshot.
